listing.name: Doraemon 3: Nobita no Machi SOS! (Dora3-64)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Upstream runtime package for Dora3-64; use own game files per documented setup, with upstream/player owning installation and runtime replacement. Observed release artifacts are evidence, not operational package selection or Portcove support. Limits: Upstream only: Upstream advertises gameplay, translations and autosave. Complete playthrough evidence Unknown; inspect Android ZIP layout before describing its install route. Linux glibc 2.43 minimum; Android README calls an APK but actual release supplies Android ZIP. Select verified asset and inspect its layout before configuring route. Upstream platforms: Windows x64, Linux x86-64 (glibc 2.43+, Vulkan), Android ARM64. Android release ZIP differs from README APK name. Original data: N64 Doraemon 3 Japan N3DJ revision 0, 16 MiB big-endian ROM. Exact source revision/hash and BIOS/firmware requirements not stated above remain Unknown in this review. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
